titleInfo.title: Classic Feynman
titleInfo.subTitle: all the adventures of a curious character

physicalDescription.extent: x, 511 p. : ill. ; 25 cm. + 1 sound disc (digital ; 4 3/4 in.)

abstract.#text: Presents a collection of stories and lectures by world-renowned physicist Richard Feyman, the 1965 Nobel Prize winner in physics who helped to develop the atomic bomb. Includes audio CD.

tableOfContents.#text: Prologue. To the reader / by Ralph Leighton ; Foreword / by Freeman Dyson. -- From far Rockaway to MIT. The making of a scientist ; He fixes radios by thinking! ; String beans ; Who stole the door? ; Always trying to escape ; The chief research chemist of the Metaplast Corporation. -- The Princeton years. "Surely you're joking, Mr. Feynman!" ; Monster minds ; A different box of tools ; It's a simple as one, two, three ..." ; Meeeeeeeee! ; Mind readers ; Mixing paints ; Latin or Italian! -- Arlene. "What do y̲o̲u̲ care what other people think?" -- Feynman, the military, and the bomb. Fizzled fuses ; Los Alamos from below (spoken version on commemorative CD inside back cover) ; Safecracker meets safecracker ; Uncle Sam doesn't need you! -- From Cornell to Caltech with a touch of Brazil. The dignified professor ; Any questions? ; I want my dollar! ; You just ask them? ; O Americano, outra vez! ; Getting ahead ; Lucky numbers ; Certainly, Mr. Big! ; An offer you must refuse ; Man of a thousand tongues.

note.#text: Richard P. Feynman ; edited by Ralph Leighton.

note: Accompanying CD has title: Los Alamos from below.
